ch.x: 30 days of active guided learning and 1 year access to the material.
Its a combination of pre-recorded lessons, groups chats, quizzes and assignments. The 30 day guide learning path startsat the beginning of every month.
Yes, there is a Certificate of Attendance
Yes we do allow 2-3 instalments and you only join after you finish paying.
How deep or advanced is the information?
The information is designed for beginners and intermediate users, not advanced users. Most people who join are complete beginners,
Is Content Creation School for beginners or for advanced users?
We have entreprenuers with over 20 years experience and students with zero years experience. What they both share in common is that they are at beginner level when it comes to digital skills.
Do you teach all the listed courses?

Yes we do. Its an intensive 30 days online learning program and the good news is that you will have upto 1 years access to the learning materials and if you did not manage to go through the intended lessons, you can still catch up later.
Is the price per skill or does it cover all the listed skills?
One price covers all the listed skills. Content Creation School is a 30-day an intensive learning program. We will guide you on what to focus on depending on your goals.
